description: Turns sixteen voltages from the patch into MIDI CC messages sent out to a device, one per cell of the grid

inputs.text: 0V to 10V sets the value 0 to 127 of the CC number printed in the cell above, sent out whenever the voltage changes

notes: nothing is sent until a MIDI device is chosen and each cell has been given a CC number
click a cell and type the CC number it should send
the driver, device and channel are picked by left-clicking the three lines of the display, each of which opens a menu of its own; none of them is on the panel's right-click menu
the module has no menu items of its own
